acts.label: Prologue
acts.desc: Mika Westwolf was killed in a hit-and-run on a Montana highway. Her parents thought the driver might get away with it. The driver was white. Mika was a citizen of the Blackfeet Nation.

acts.label: Act One
acts.desc: Mika’s parents, Carissa Heavy Runner and Kevin Howard, share recordings of their interactions with law enforcement.

acts.label: Act Two
acts.desc: Carissa and Kevin take matters into their own hands.

acts.label: Act Three
acts.desc: The county prosecutor explains why he let Mika’s killer out of jail. Will Carissa and Kevin's efforts pay off? Sierra follows them to court.

songs.t: Old Dirt Road (A Love Song to My Home)
